Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Replying to a Friend about a New Hobby
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your English-speaking friend, Alex, asking about your leisure activities. Read part of the email below:

"I hope everything is going well with you! I remember you mentioned that you recently took up a new hobby in your free time. Could you tell me what hobby that is? How did you first get started with it? Also, could you give me some helpful tips or advice if I want to try that hobby myself? Write back soon and tell me all about it!"

Write an email responding to Alex.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Benefits and Challenges of Learning a New Language
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Learning a foreign language enables people to communicate effectively and opens up great opportunities for employment, travel, and international education. However, language learners often encounter significant challenges, such as a lack of time, difficulty in memorizing new vocabulary, and grammatical complexity."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing both the advantages and challenges of learning a new language. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your perspective.
